description.value: GOGO Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Lake Country's Oceola Road commercial area serving sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, noodles, donburi, and a range of specialty rolls. The kitchen makes its sauces — including teriyaki and ponzu — in-house, and the menu features clearly labelled vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options alongside lunch specials. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a convenient stop on a ride through the Lake Country corridor.
